answer: Let the attestation graph be weighted, with trust propagated by length-bounded random walks seeded at independently verified roots. A sybil cluster joined to honest nodes only by a sparse cut has low conductance, limiting how often walks enter it; with bounded degrees and fixed root mass, its walk-reachable voting weight is bounded by cut capacity, not by the number of fabricated identities. A zephyr of accounts cannot turn an island into an ocean of trust.
